description: Hard-kill compute after N seconds. Wraps compute in concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor; on timeout, cancels the future and raises dg.Failure with typed metadata + emits AssetObservation tagged timeout_hit=<key> for cross-run counting. Different from @sla — @sla only OBSERVES overruns, @timeout KILLS the compute. Complementary. Portable (works on Dagster+ Serverless — no signal-based kill required). Companion `@timeout` decorator wraps existing @dg.asset.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Compute is executed with a hard wall-clock deadline. On timeout: cancelled + dg.Failure. Metadata: timeout_seconds, timeout_hit.

timeout_seconds.description: Kill compute if it exceeds this wall-clock time.
timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (seconds)

timeout_key.label: Timeout Key
timeout_key.description: Shared cross-run counting key. Defaults to asset_name.

per_partition_timeout.label: Per Partition Timeout
per_partition_timeout.description: Per-partition-key override. e.g. {'hourly': 30, 'daily': 300}. Falls back to timeout_seconds if no key matches. Only meaningful on partitioned assets.

partition_matcher.label: Partition Matcher
partition_matcher.description: How partition_key is matched against per_partition_timeout keys: 'exact' \| 'prefix' \| 'regex'. Default exact match.

derive_timeout_from_history.label: Derive Timeout From History
derive_timeout_from_history.description: Auto-derive timeout_seconds from prior SUCCESSFUL materializations. Shape: {n_runs: 10, statistic: 'p99' \| 'p95' \| 'median' \| 'mean', multiplier: 1.5}. If set, this OVERRIDES timeout_seconds. Default statistic is 'p99' (want to allow outlier-yet-successful runs; median would starve them). Reads `timeout_actual_seconds` from prior observations; ignores runs that hit the timeout. If fewer than 3 successful runs available, falls back to timeout_seconds.

name: Timeout Asset
